TASK 6 — LAN discovery fixes.

Files: `android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`, `lib/data/lan_discovery_service.dart`, `lib/features/welcome/add_server_screen.dart`.

Context: The captain has NOT changed these. iOS `Info.plist` Bonjour types stay `_navidrome._tcp` / `_subsonic._tcp` — do NOT modify them.

1. `AndroidManifest.xml`: add this permission near the existing `NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES`, location permissions, and `INTERNET`:
   `<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE" />`
   Keep all existing permissions; just add this one.

2. `lan_discovery_service.dart`: The plan states `start()`, `_startType()`, and `ServiceStatus.changed` already clear old errors / write errors / update results — DO NOT rewrite that logic. Only add the failure-state cleanup: after it attempts to start BOTH discovery types (navidrome + subsonic), if NEITHER started successfully, set `state.searching = false` (while keeping the last error message). Read the file to find where the two discoveries are kicked off and add the guard there.

3. `add_server_screen.dart`: In the LAN discovery results UI, when there are NO discovered servers OR `state.error != null`, show a simple failure hint plus a refresh entry (reuse existing l10n keys already present: `noServersFound`, `ensureSameNetwork`, `lanRefresh`, `searchingLan`). Do NOT build a complex error page — just a small inline message + a button that re-triggers discovery.

Verification: Do NOT run builds (captain does). If the edit tool says "file changed since it was read", re-read the file fully and retry. Report when done.
